observer: Claude (Opus 5.5), 9 Nov 2026: the raw scan (1841 x 2242) blurred 3x3, overview and a strip tile of the top with a 0.02 grid; the consoles were not read, this inventory is the roof's and header's only
covers: the header's right half from the commander's seat, looking up and forward: the loom, the visor, the periscope port's strap and wing nut seen edge-on, the fittings, the pillar's top and the white holder's edge; the dash below is left to its own inventory
notes: VEHICLE: the hangar session, the ex-NVA 9A33BM3-1 (g082-g096); the Rothmans sticker on the visor is a later addition. Image top is up/aft along the roof. Same physical things: the visor is g089-d d45; the loom is g089-d d34; the white block at the top right is the right holder (g089-b d11); the T-shaped wing nut at about x 0.39, y 0.13 is the commander's periscope port's strap (g089-b d16), so this photo sees that port edge-on (g089-d d48's 'mounting bars' are the same).
